from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0001.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
print('u    v    D      x       y')
for u in range(0,512,16):
    c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
    if not len(c): print(u,'none'); continue
    v=int(c.min())
    if v<=256: continue
    D=396.8/(v-256); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    print('%3d %4d %6.2f %7.2f %7.2f'%(u,v,D,L,D))
" 2>/dev/null
